Did you know the original Tarzan was filmed in Algeria? 🇩🇿🌴 This is the Jardin d’Essai du Hamma in Algiers; one of the most incredible botanical gardens I’ve ever visited. It was created in 1832 as an experimental garden, where plants from around the world were introduced and tested to see what could grow in Algeria’s climate. Today, the garden is a huge green oasis in the middle of Algiers. And in 1932, this jungle like setting became the location where the original Tarzan was filmed. When you come to Algeria, you can’t miss this beautiful botanical garden. #algeria #algiers #solotravel #moviescene #tarzan
